title: Code and data for "Environmental fluctuation limits gene regulation unless it can be tracked"
description: Simulation code, per-run data, pre-registered analysis scripts and their outputs, and manuscript sources for the paper "Environmental fluctuation limits gene regulation unless it can be tracked" (Osman, in preparation). The study uses R-Aevol, in which gene regulation arises from transcription factors encoded in a DNA-like sequence, to separate environmental fluctuation from the information available for tracking it (informative, absent and yoked cues), and EvoSim, the Julia simulator in which the study began.
